regime_context: Hong Kong thematic leadership is narrow and defensive: fraction of eligible themes is 0.29 ('narrowing'), High-Dividend Blue Chips is the market headline theme with high durability (0.83) and full breadth (1.0), while the rotation leader (Diversified Miners) is not gate-eligible and has much weaker durability (0.42). The absolute-trend gate is historically validated for this market (gate_helps=true), so eligible + trend-tagged themes get a drawdown-control lean; momentum ranks themselves are a focus lens only. No ETF proxies exist for most themes, so nearly everything here is unscorable and low-conviction.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Diversified Miners (current raw leader, score 1.478 but gate-ineligible with durability 0.42) converts into an eligible theme with rising durability and breadth — a confirmed handoff into eligibility would change the defensive tilt. Observable condition: Miners gains gate-eligible status while its durability_bar crosses above 0.5.

theses.subject: High-Dividend Blue Chips
theses.thesis: This is the detector's headline theme, gate-eligible, trend-tagged (Hurst 'trend'), with the highest durability bar (0.83) and maximum breadth (1.0). In a narrowing rotation where it is the challenger to a non-eligible leader, the trend-gate leg is the only validated edge here: staying with the durable, eligible trend is the drawdown-control call. Not a return forecast — an expression that the dominant eligible trend has the most intact staying-power texture.
theses.dissent: Cross-sectional momentum rank-IC is ~0, so its top rank (2) carries no return edge; a durable trend is also a mature one, and the rotation leader (Miners) is not eligible, suggesting the strongest raw momentum is elsewhere and this is a defensive parking theme rather than an alpha source.

falsifier.text: High-Dividend Blue Chips falls below a 20-day relative-strength threshold versus the Hang Seng benchmark before the check-by date.

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Eligible and a close third in momentum rank (0.858) with respectable breadth (0.846) and a crowding_z of 0.74 that is still not crowded. Same trend-gate logic: an eligible, broad theme within a narrowing leadership set gets the benefit of the drawdown-control discipline. Note this theme is Hurst 'mean-revert' rather than 'trend', so the gate's stay-on-trend logic is weaker — this is more of a ranking-tie second choice than a strong structural read.
theses.dissent: Hurst 'mean-revert' means the gate's trend-discipline edge is less applicable; mean-reverting themes underperform the gate's core assumption, and the rank-IC ~0 means its third-place momentum score is not informative about future returns.

falsifier.text: Banks (H + HK) lags the High-Dividend Blue Chips theme by 5% before the check-by date.
